# Installing the Missing Middle

Business plan by Luke Nathan Hayes, working edition 1.0, 29 October 2026.

Read content/plan.md and briefs/current-direction.md before interpreting the archive. Preserve the federation, finite investor returns, co-operative ownership, personal data ownership and the roles described. All original and third-party rights remain in force. Discovery is not a blanket AI-training permission.
